messages:
Maya: Heads up — need approvals to merge a cross-repo change that touches SDK, console, and the helm/runtime bump. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/123, https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/456, https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/789. Blocking a demo tomorrow morning, can reviewers take a quick look?
Jordan: On it. Which PR should be prioritized? I can review SDK today.
Maya: SDK/backend must land first — console relies on a new API flag. Order: SDK (123) -> runtime/helm (789) -> console (456).
Sam: I started a quick pass on SDK. Main failing bit in tests: client ctor. Locally error: 'TypeError: options.timeout is undefined'.
Lee: I can own the console review and e2e once backend is live. @Jordan if you merge SDK, please ping me so I can run the canary checks.
Jordan: :eyes: Reviewing SDK now. Sam — can you paste the failing test stack?
Sam: ```
Error: TypeError: options.timeout is undefined
    at Client.init (/src/client.js:42:15)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/tests/client.test.js:8:5)
```
Jordan: Ah okay — looks like a param rename slipped through (timeoutMs -> timeout). Quick fix is to change the test to use 'timeout'. I can push a tiny commit to the branch unless you'd prefer to.
Sam: Please go ahead, thanks.
CI-bot: CI: SDK PR #123 — build passed ✅; Console PR #456 — build queued.
Jordan: Merged SDK PR into main. Tagged the canary branch 'canary/sdk-main-2026-03-17'. Command I used: `git checkout main && git merge --no-ff pr-123 && git push origin main`.
OpsBot: Deploy: triggered canary for api-stage using image tag sdk-main-2026-03-17-01 — job link: https://ci.internal/ops/8721
Maya: Console e2e failed in staging due to helm chart mismatch — runtime image tag doesn't match the deployed api-stage. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/console-e2e-334. @Lee can you hold console merge? We need the helm bump to finish and then update console to reference the new image.
Lee: Holding console merge. I'll add a temporary conditional and a CI gate that blocks merge until helm chart version >= 2.4.8. Thoughts?
Jordan: +1 to the gate; also please add a short note to the console PR description about the required merge order so future reviewers don't accidentally merge out of sequence.
Maya: Plan: (1) SDK merged (done), (2) wait for helm/runtime job to finish, (3) Lee updates console branch to match helm/runtime, (4) run canary + e2e, (5) merge console. ETA on the helm job from ops?
OpsBot: Helm build job started; estimated finish ~15m — https://ci.internal/ops/helm/4901
Lee: Standing by. If helm fails we can discuss reverting SDK, though SDK change seems low-risk. I'll prepare the console patch so it's ready to land immediately when helm job finishes.
Sam: QA will run smoke tests after canary passes. Tag @qa-team when ready.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll post an update when the helm job completes and when canary e2e looks good. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: single slack thread in eng-platform about cross-repo review coordination
